# norm issuer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/normIssuer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The agent or standpoint according to which this norm holds — the constitutional keystone: there is no ought, only ought-according-to. DOMAIN-FREE on purpose: [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md) specializes this property for NormativeSystems, and a domain of [`Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) would leak [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) typing onto every system through the subproperty (review); issuance applies to norms, systems, and future deontic carriers alike. The range is intentionally open (a [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual, the [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) convention). [`normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is documented, not axiomatised ([`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is an AnnotationProperty; the vantage precedent). NOT functional: co-issued norms (a treaty, a joint policy) carry several issuers, and those claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
